user.title: Connect your RFLink gateway
user.description: Select the serial port your RFLink gateway is attached to. Using a `/dev/serial/by-id/…` path is recommended, because it survives a reboot even if the device number changes.

data_description.port: Pick a detected port, or choose "Enter manually" for a network gateway.

manual_port.title: Enter the port manually
manual_port.description: Enter a serial path such as `/dev/serial/by-id/usb-1a86_USB2.0-Serial-if00-port0`, or a network URL such as `socket://192.168.1.50:2001` (ser2net) or `rfc2217://192.168.1.50:2001`.

usb_confirm.title: RFLink gateway discovered
usb_confirm.description: Do you want to set up the RFLink gateway found on {port}?

error.cannot_connect: Could not open that port. Check that the gateway is plugged in and not in use by another integration.

abort.already_configured: This gateway is already set up.
abort.wrong_port: That port belongs to a different gateway.

data_description.automatic_add: Create a device as soon as an unknown 433 MHz signal is received. Turn this off again once your devices have been found.
data_description.signal_repetitions: How many times each outgoing command is sent. Increase this for devices that miss commands.
data_description.keepalive: How often a PING is sent to detect a dead connection.

user.title: Add a switch
user.description: Press a button on your remote first, then pick the device below. You can also type an ID manually, for example `NewKaku_008cbc9b_1`.

data_description.aliases: Extra IDs that control the same device, for protocols that RFLink sometimes decodes differently.

user.title: Add a light
user.description: Press a button on your remote first, then pick the device below. You can also type an ID manually, for example `NewKaku_008cbc9b_1`.

data_description.light_type: How commands are sent: dimmable sends levels, hybrid sends a level followed by ON, switchable only sends ON/OFF, toggle sends ON to flip the state.
data_description.aliases: Extra IDs that control the same device.

user.title: Add a cover
user.description: Roller shutters and blinds. Press a button on your remote first, then pick the device below.

data_description.inverted: Enable this for protocols where UP and DOWN are reversed, such as some KlikAanKlikUit motors.

user.title: Add a binary sensor
user.description: Motion detectors, door and window contacts, smoke alarms and doorbells.

data_description.off_delay: Turn the sensor off automatically after this many seconds. Use this for devices that only send a trigger, such as PIR sensors.

user.title: Add a sensor
user.description: Weather stations, thermometers, rain gauges and power meters. Every measurement the device reports becomes its own entity.

data_description.force_update: Write a new state even when the value did not change, so "last updated" always reflects the last reading. This increases database usage.
data_description.aliases: Extra IDs for the same physical sensor, for protocols that RFLink sometimes decodes as a different brand.

send_command.name: Send RF command
send_command.description: Sends a protocol command through the RFLink gateway.

protocol.name: Protocol
protocol.description: The RFLink protocol name, for example Kaku, NewKaku or Unitec.

command.name: Command
command.description: The rest of the packet, for example 1a4a;4;ON.

send_raw.name: Send raw packet
send_raw.description: Sends a complete RFLink packet without any processing. Useful for gateway commands such as GPIOset.

simulate_packet.name: Simulate packet
simulate_packet.description: Feeds a packet into the integration as if it was received, for testing and for discovering devices without hardware.

packet.name: Packet
packet.description: The raw RFLink packet, for example 20;01;Kaku;ID=1234abcd;SWITCH=1;CMD=ON;.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Which gateway should receive the packet. Defaults to all of them.

send_failed.message: Could not send the command to the RFLink gateway: {error}

raw_timings_unsupported.message: RFLink gateways cannot transmit raw timings. Use the "Send RF command" or "Send raw packet" action instead.

no_loaded_gateway.message: There is no loaded RFLink gateway to send this packet to.
